episodes.title: Welcome to New Raccoon City
episodes.summary: While on a research mission, Jade crosses paths with a gang of scavengers. Years earlier, Jade and Billie try to make a fresh start in New Raccoon City.When the Wesker kids move to New Raccoon City, the secrets they uncover might just be the end of everything.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.summary: To elude Umbrella, Jade seeks help from an unlikely source. As Albert tries to cover for his daughters, Billie begins to exhibit troubling symptoms.

episodes.title: The Light
episodes.summary: Jade helps guide a small group of survivors into the Chunnel, but terror awaits. Albert warns Umbrella about Joy's horrific side effects.

episodes.title: The Turn
episodes.summary: Jade and Baxter find themselves at the mercy of the Brotherhood's demented leader. Teenage Jade and Billie receive distressing news about their father.

episodes.title: Home Movies
episodes.summary: With Simon offering tech advice, Jade and Billie break into their father's laptop, where a chilling message leads them to a nightmarish discovery.

episodes.title: Someone's Little Girl
episodes.summary: Following a shocking reunion, Jade finds her way back to her family. Later, she and Amrita make a potentially life-altering discovery.

episodes.title: Parasite
episodes.summary: Reeling from a devastating loss, Jade calculates her next move. Years earlier, Jade and Billie learn there's more to their father than ever imagined.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.summary: With Umbrella forces closing in, Jade encourages the use of a monstrous weapon. Teenage Jade enlists Simon on a fateful mission into Umbrella's HQ.
